description_en: Downloads the query diagnostic records of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 下载AnalyticDB PostgreSQL的实例的查询诊断记录
name: DownloadDiagnosisRecords

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to view the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The query filter conditions in JSON format. Valid values:

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`: The 100 queries with the longest execution duration.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`: Completed queries.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`: Running queries.
`{"Type":"cost","Max":"200"}`: Short-duration queries, which are queries with an execution duration of less than 200 milliseconds.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"200","Max":"60000"}`: Medium-duration queries, which are queries with an execution duration of 200 milliseconds or more but less than 1 minute.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"60000"}`: Long-duration queries, which are queries with an execution duration of 1 minute or more.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`: Custom-duration queries. You can specify the minimum and maximum execution duration of the queries. Min specifies the minimum execution duration, and Max specifies the maximum execution duration. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
查询过滤条件，JSON格式，取值如下：

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`：耗时最长的100个查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`：已完成的查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`：运行中的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Max":"200"}`：短耗时查询，执行耗时小于200毫秒的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"200","Max":"60000"}`：中等耗时查询，执行耗时大于等于200毫秒且小于1分钟的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"60000"}`：长耗时查询，执行耗时大于等于1分钟的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`：自定义耗时查询，您可以自定义设置查询的最短耗时和最长耗时，Min表示最短耗时；Max表示最长耗时，单位为毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: query_condition

parameters.help_en:
The language of the downloaded file. Valid values:

zh: Simplified Chinese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese.
zh-tw: Traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
下载文件的语言，取值如下：

zh：简体中文。
en：英文。
ja：日语。
zh-tw：繁体中文
parameters.name: lang
